title: Multi-domain external validation of tracking uncertainty
research_question: Does the frozen uncertainty-aware tracking pipeline rank association errors and protect downstream motion summaries after bounded sequence-01 calibration when evaluated once on separately locked sequence-02 data from two previously unused real Cell Tracking Challenge domains?
primary_claim_if_go: After calibration on sequence 01, tracking uncertainty generalizes to held-out sequence 02 within both GOWT1 fluorescence and HeLa DIC domains, ranks association errors better than a distance-confidence baseline, and improves selective reliability.
secondary_claim_if_go: Uncertainty-aware trajectory handling reduces downstream motion-summary error relative to hard tracking in a majority of pre-registered dataset-endpoint comparisons.

immutable_upstream_evidence.stage_d_supported_scope: within-Huh7 sequence generalization after sequence-01 calibration

allowed_on_sequence_01: threshold selection defined before sequence-02 access
adaptation_boundary.implementation_freeze_requirement: The complete evaluator, fitted sequence-01 artifact and all thresholds must be committed with passing CI before the one-time sequence-02 evaluation.

development_implementation.radius_selection_rule: maximize clean nearest-neighbour link F1; exact ties select the lower max-speed gate
development_implementation.probability_calibration: temperature scaling fit only on sequence-01 corrupted-development scenarios
development_implementation.association_error_auprc_definition: Rank association errors with score 1 - correct-link confidence and label 1 - true_link.

locked_evaluation_implementation.posterior_track_rule: greedily retain a one-to-one compatible link set ordered by decreasing calibrated probability and stable observation IDs

primary_endpoints.name: association_error_auprc
primary_endpoints.purpose: rank incorrect links under class imbalance

primary_endpoints.name: selective_link_risk_at_80_percent_coverage
primary_endpoints.purpose: measure retained-link error after abstaining on the 20 percent most uncertain links

validity_requirements: All archive, manifest and split hashes match.
No locked-test field contributes to fitting, calibration, selection or debugging.
All artifact-contract, compatibility and reproducibility tests pass.
Both real locked tests produce complete registered primary endpoints.
GO: On both real locked sequence-02 tests, calibrated association-error AUPRC is strictly higher than distance-confidence AUPRC.
On both real locked sequence-02 tests, link risk at 80 percent coverage is strictly lower than link risk at full coverage.
On both real locked sequence-02 tests, calibrated Brier score is no worse than the uncalibrated pipeline, and mean ECE across the two tests is lower.
Uncertainty-aware motion summaries have lower absolute error than hard tracking in at least five of the eight registered real-dataset endpoint comparisons.
decision_policy.REVISE: All validity requirements pass, but one or more GO gates fail. The project closes with a bounded negative or mixed technical result; locked tests may not be tuned and rerun as confirmation.
decision_policy.STOP: A provenance, leakage, compatibility or exact-reproduction requirement fails, or a required real locked test cannot produce the primary endpoints.
decision_policy.synthetic_role: SIM+ is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy or rescue a real-data GO gate.

reporting_rules: Report every registered dataset and endpoint, including failures and undefined values.
Retain zero-shot, calibrated and baseline outputs separately.
Report 95 percent track-cluster bootstrap intervals as technical uncertainty only, not animal-level inference.
Do not pool cells or tracks and describe them as biological replicates.
Do not use GlioTrace as quantitative evidence without independent reference labels.

deferred_work.stage_f: future biological-hypothesis study requiring independent biological replicates
deferred_work.stage_g: future perturbation study requiring control and perturbation groups
deferred_work.project_completion_target: Stage E-Final report plus reproducible v1.0 release; Stage F and G are outside the current project claim.
